syAt pUjAsu pravarAvimO ॥” * ॥ prakarzeRa namanam । tadviDiryaTA, kAlikApurARe । “SiromatpAdayoH kftvA bAhuByAYca parasparam । prapannaM pAhi mAmISa BItaM mftyugrahArRavAt ॥” kiYcAgame । “dorByAM padByAYca jAnuByAmurasA SirasA dfSA । manasA vacasA ceti praRAmo'zwANga IritaH ॥ * ॥ jAnuByAYcEva bAhuByAM SirasA vacasA DiyA । paYcANgakaH praRAmaH syAt pUjAsu pravarAvimO ॥” iti ॥ * ॥ “garuqaM caturvviMSattadardDakam ॥ namettadardDamaTavA tadardDaM sarvvadA namet ॥” * ॥ vizRuDarmmottare । “devArccAdarSanAdeva praRamenmaDusUdanam । sTAnApekzA na karttavyA dfzwvArccAM dvijasattamAH ॥ devArccAdfzwipUtaM hi Suci sarvvaM prakIrttitam ॥” * ॥ aTa namaskAramAhAtmyam । nArasiMhe । “namaskAraH smfto yajYaH sarvvayajYezu cottamaH । namaskAreRa cEkena naraH pUto hariM vrajet ॥” skAnde । “daRqapraRAmaM kurute vizRave BaktiBAvataH । reRusaNKyAM vaset svarge manvantaraSataM naraH ॥” tatrEva brahmanAradasaMvAde । “praRamya daRqavadBUmO namaskAreRa yo'rccayet । sa yAM gatimavApnoti na tAM kratuSatErapi । namaskAreRa cEkena naraH pUto hariM vrajet ॥” tatrEva SrISivomAsaMvAde । “BUmimApIqya jAnuByAM Sira Aropya vE Buvi । praRamedyo hi deveSaM so'SvameDaPalaM laBet ॥” tatrEvAnyatra । “tIrTakowisahasrARi tIrTakowiSatAni ca । nArAyaRapraRAmasya kalAM nArhanti zoqaSIm ॥ SAWyenApi namaskAraM kurvvataH SArNgaDanvane । SatajanmArjjitaM pApaM tatkzaRAdeva naSyati ॥ reRumaRqitagAtrasya kaRA dehe Bavanti ye । tAvadvarzasahasrARi vizRuloke mahIyate ॥” vizRuDarmmottare । “aBivAdya jagannATaM kftArTaSca taTA Bavet । namaskArakriyA tasya sarvvapApapraRASinI ॥ jAnuByAYcEva pARiByAM SirasA ca vicakzaRaH । kftvA praRAmaM devasya sarvvAn kAmAnavApnuyAt ॥” vizRupurARe । “anAdiniDanaM devaM dEtyadAnavadAraRam । ye namanti narA nityaM na hi paSyanti te yamam ॥ ye janA jagatAM nATaM nityaM nArAyaRaM dvijAH । namanti na hi te vizRoH sTAnAdanyatra gAminaH ॥” nAradIye । “eko'pi kfzRasya kftaH praRAmo daSASvameDAvaBfTErna tulyaH । daSASvameDI punareti janma kfzRapraRAmI na punarBavAya ॥” hariBaktisuDodaye । “vizRorddaRqapraRAmArTaM Baktena patatA Buvi । pAtitaM pAtakaM kftsnaM nottizWati punaH saha ॥” skAnde devahUtavikuRqalasaMvAde । “tapastaptvA naro GoramaraRye niyatendriyaH । yat PalaM sa samApnoti tannatvA garuqaDvajam ॥ kftvApi bahuSaH pApaM naro mohasamanvitaH । na yAti narakaM natvA sarvvapApaharaM harim ॥” tatrEva vedaniDistutO । “api pApaM durAcAraM naraM tvatpraRataM hare । nekzante kiNkarA yAmyA ulUkAstapanaM yaTA ॥” vizRupurARe SrIyamasya nijaBawAnuSAsane । “harimamaragaRArccitANGripadmaM praRamati yaH paramArTato hi martyaH । tamapagatasamastapApabanDaM vraja parihftya yaTAgnimAjyasiktam ॥” brahmavEvartte । “SaraRAgatarakzaRodyataM harimISaM praRamanti ye narAH । na patanti BavAmbuDO sPuwaM patitAnudDarati sma tAnasO ॥” azwamaskanDe ca balivAkye । “aho praRAmAya kftaH samudyamaH prapannaBaktArTaviDO samAhitaH । yallokapAlEstadanugraho'marEralabDapUrvvo'pasade'sure'rpitaH ॥” ataeva nArAyaRavyUhastave । “aho BAgyamaho BAgyamaho BAgyaM nfRAmidam । yezAM haripadAbjAgre Siro nyastaM yaTA taTA ॥” kiYca । nArasiMhe SrIyamoktO । “tasya vE nArasiMhasya vizRoramitatejasaH । praRAmaM ye prakurvvanti tezAmapi namo namaH ॥” Bavizyottare ca jalaDenuprasaNge । “vizRorddevajagadDAturjanArddanajagatpateH । praRAmaM ye prakurvvanti tezAmapi namo namaH ॥” ityAdi ॥ * ॥ aTa praRAmanityatA । bfhannAradIye lubDakopAKyAnAramBe । “sakfdvA na namedyastu vizRave SarmmakAriRe । SabopamaM vijAnIyAt kadAcidapi nAlapet ॥” kiYca । pAdme vESAKamAhAtmye yamabrAhmaRasaMvAde । “paSyanto BagavaddvAraM nAma SastraparicCadam । akftvA tatpraRAmAdi yAnti te narakOkasaH ॥” * ॥ aTa namaskAre nizidDAni । vizRusmftO । “janmapraBfti yatkiYcit pumAn vE DarmmamAcaret । sarvvaM tannizPalaM yAti ekahastABivAdanAt ॥” vArAhe । “vastraprAvftadehastu yo naraH praRameta mAm । SvitrI sa jAyate mUrKaH saptajanmani BAmini ! ॥” kiYcAnyatra । “agre pfzWe vAmaBAge samIpe garBamandire । japahomanamaskArAnna kuryyAt keSavAlaye ॥” api ca । “sakfdBUmO nipatito na SaktaH praRamenmuhuH । utTAyotTAya karttavyaM daRqavat praRipAtanam ॥” iti SrIhariBaktivilAse 8 vilAsaH ॥ nativiSezastu yAmale । “trikoRAkArA sarvvatra natiH SakteH samIritA । dakziRAdvAyavIM gatvA Ā. -णयति, ˚ते to lead forwards, conduct, advance, promote, further, RV. &c. &c.; to bring or lead to, convey (esp. the sacrificial fire or water or Soma to its place at the altar), ib.; to offer, present, Bhaṭṭ.; to produce, perform, execute, finish, Up.; MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to do away with, remove, dispel, MBh.; to manifest affection, love, desire, MBh.; to show, represent (a drama), Bālar.; Prasannar.; to inflict (as punishment), Mn.; MBh. &c.; to apply (as a clyster), Car.; to establish, fix, institute, promulgate, teach, MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to write, compose, Sarvad.; (Ā.) to draw in (the breath), ŚBr. : Desid. -निनीषति (!), to wish to lead or conduct, RV.
